Add your portrait here and name the actual image file:

profile.jpg

Repository path: dist/assets/profile/profile.jpg

Use your JPG portrait, not the screenshot of the file's Properties window.
Your current 399 x 559 pixel image is supported. No resizing is required.
The portrait frame preserves the image proportions and does not stretch it.
Until you add the photo, the portfolio keeps a W / AY monogram.

If Windows hides file extensions, rename the file to profile and confirm its
type is JPG, so it becomes profile.jpg rather than profile.jpg.jpg.
Commit the image along with the portfolio update. No further code edit is needed.
